news.body:
## Something you have probably not seen
- Tata Group is running an internship info session for Asia on 10 December.
Registration closes on 7 December at 4pm and the joining link only comes after you register, so the cutoff is the real date. It was the last item in the pre-MBA newsletter on the 22nd. - It lands the day after you leave Locus, so it is worth deciding before you are off the payroll.
## Two you can get ahead of
- AON present the student medical cover on 3 December, a week before your own insurance deadline.
Your French health cover task has not moved since early October and is dated the 10th. That session is the thing that answers it, and both are already on your calendar.
- Club 8 has been quiet for a week.
You wrote to them on the 19th about the room and the keys and nothing has come back. - Worth a second line today.
